root_cause.summary: Not a double-import bug: uid is globally unique, barcode partial-unique index has zero live violations, and NULL barcode is nearly absent from duplicate-group rows (2 of 1093). Every inspected 'fully branded' duplicate pair has two different, individually valid barcodes under identical brand+name text. seed_obf.py dedupes only in-memory, within a single run, keyed on exact barcode — no brand+name text dedup exists anywhere in the pipeline. Most consistent explanation: OBF's own upstream dataset already lists the same named product under multiple distinct barcodes (regional SKU variants / repeat community submissions), imported faithfully as separate rows. Cross-source (vials_seed vs obf_import) duplication confirmed via docs/database/db-update-log-2026-07-25.md's '2 held' unresolved barcode collisions — one found live in the corpus (the ordinary granactive retinoid 2% emulsion); the second not found by text-matching, likely undercounted due to name-formatting differences between sources.
